about: Vietnam detailed round (2 Nov 2026): which researched figures the book uses and why; every unused item with its reason. build-world.py does the arithmetic (VAT-inclusive ÷ 1.10 — vat.json VN; a range → its midpoint; several items → median). Machine decisions live in ../machines-asia/decisions.json (VN), refs 'vn-machines#i'.

fx.why: the State Bank of Vietnam central rate (its own newspaper; a second paper agrees) crossed with the ECB US$/£ — the same method as every central-bank book; Vietcombank's published GBP transfer-buy 34,093 / sell 35,186 brackets it

labour.keep: JETRO FY2025 burden (manufacturing, Japanese affiliates, fully loaded)
labour.why: GSO 2024 machine-operator income 8,715.7 thousand VND/month × 12 × 1.215 employer contributions = 127.1 M VND/yr ≈ US$4,960 at the 2024 level v JETRO's US$5,270 (base + allowances + bonus) — within 6 %, so JETRO stays; GSO has no manufacturing-only split by occupation

rent.why: Cushman & Wakefield Q2 2026 ready-built factory asking rents, Northern 5.0 and Southern 4.9 US$/m²/month (incl. service charge, ex-VAT) — the mean of the two industrial regions

mat.pp.why: PP homopolymer: a recorded Vietnamese deal (PPH-T03, 19 Oct 2026, VAT not stated) and a Vietnamese-made BSR T3034 offer (VAT-inclusive)

rejected.polymers#18/#19: copolymer (the family's base is the homopolymer)

mat.lldpe.why: LLDPE C4 film grade: a recorded deal (20 Oct) and an offer (VAT-inclusive)

mat.hips.why: HIPS 476L recorded deal, 10 Sep 2026 (VAT not stated)

mat.abs.why: ABS ZA0211: a recorded 15 t deal (29 Oct) and an offer (VAT-inclusive)

mat.hdpe.why: HDPE in Vietnam: a recorded deal (43,000), an offer (VAT-inclusive) and a domestic market survey (29,500–34,500 ex-VAT) — the sources disagree, so the median — the re-check: the survey's domestic range is about the CFR SE Asia price the same page quotes

mat.pvc.why: S-PVC offers into Vietnam, Thai and Indonesian, US$750–760/t CFR (26 Aug 2026 — no later open figure) — the re-check: the page puts the offers 'in Vietnam' by context, gives no CFR basis, and they are for September shipment; Low

rejected.polymers#26: a CFR SE Asia range, not Vietnam

mat.nr_tsr20.why: SVR 10 (the TSR10/20 class) Vietnam average export price, June 2026 (MOIT / Customs) — an export FOB price, what the grade fetches at the border

mat.scrap_hms.why: US HMS 80:20 bulk scrap CFR Vietnam, 21 Sep 2026 (BigMint) — the steel-foundry charge's melt stock

mat.cu_premium.why: 8 mm copper rod premium CIF Vietnam (SMM, 30 Oct) — the page says 'Premium … (USD/tonne)', read here as over LME (SMM's convention for the series; the page does not say so); a rod premium sits a little above a cathode premium; Low

mat.al_sheet_asp.why: 6061 plate / sheet, Vietnamese average mid-2026 (VAT not stated) — the floor of the aluminium sheet family; Low — the re-check: an 'average' in a dealer's sales text, no currency symbol (VND by context), full sheet or cut size not stated

notUsed.bar steels (C45, 42CrMo4, 38MnVS6, 20MnC: metals#0–#4 are undated dealer pages (one auto-dates itself); 38MnVS6 / 20MnCr5 not found anywhere — need a Mysteel subscription or a supplier quote
notUsed.stainless: 304 / 316L sheet are stockist cut-sheet prices, conflicting (316L 115,000 v ~150,000); the family's base is mill coil
notUsed.aluminium bar / billet / ADC12: 6061 bar undated; billet only a processing fee; ADC12 undated (the SEA TH figure stays)
notUsed.pipe and sheet products: Bình Minh pipe lists and cut-sheet HDPE / ABS dealers price PRODUCTS (per metre, cut sheet), not the compound or mill sheet the library buys
notUsed.PA66 GF30, PBT, PA12: undated CIF listings with a unit error; one deal without a maker
notUsed.CRC / HDG: FOB China export references — the CFR SE Asia (TH) figures stay

recheck: verdicts.json (independent page re-check, 2 Nov 2026): 24 of 24 confirmed — every number, unit, product, lot and date as recorded; caveats below
